intake.description: Another vehicle jumped a signal at a junction and struck the right side of the claimant's car, causing damage to the right doors and pillar. At the time of the incident, the claimant was driving for a food-ordering app to deliver an order.
intake.severity_reason: The estimated loss is Rs 70,000, which falls between Rs 50,000 and Rs 4,99,999.

route.reason: policy number MTR-26-52318 has prefix for motor; intake agent read the email as motor

citations.quote: Accidental damage: We pay for damage to the insured vehicle caused by collision, overturning or impact with another object, subject to MOTOR-EXC-4.1 and MOTOR-EXC-4.2.
Commercial use: We do not pay for any loss while the insured vehicle is being used for commercial use (MOTOR-DEF-1.3). This exclusion is amended by MOTOR-END-6.1.
Commercial use: Use of the insured vehicle for hire or reward, meaning carrying passengers or goods in return for payment, including work arranged through any digital platform.

coverage.reasoning: The claimant's vehicle suffered accidental damage from a collision while he was delivering an order for a food-ordering app. Although accidental damage is normally covered under MOTOR-COV-2.1, it is explicitly subject to the commercial use exclusion in MOTOR-EXC-4.2. Because delivering goods arranged through a digital platform falls under the definition of commercial use in MOTOR-DEF-1.3 and does not qualify for the cost-sharing exception in MOTOR-END-6.1, the claim is not covered.
